style.styleTitle: Charles Bentley Pinecone Christmas Wreath & Garland Set
style.toneOfVoice: Christmas at its most natural. Both pieces use dense green foliage dressed with pinecone accents, so they look finished without a single bow or added colour – and they suit scandi, botanical, and traditional schemes equally well. At 60cm the wreath is the largest we make, and it holds its own on a standard door or a feature wall. The 180cm garland suits a mantel, a doorframe, or a banister. Add ribbon and lights if you want to, or leave them as they are. For indoor use only. Keep away from open flame and heat sources. Wipe with a dry or lightly damp cloth. Store flat in a cool, dry place between seasons. Dimensions(mm): Height: 600 Width: 1800 Depth: 600.
